When Momota plays anything to the opponent's front backhand, Momota loses the point within two shots 4% of the time (n=535, 95% CI 3%-7%); typical pros lose 11% after the same shot (difference -6 points, 95% CI -8 to -4, n=9795).

At 18+ in a game, when opponents drop, wherever it lands, Momota loses the point within two shots 0% of the time (n=55, 95% CI 0%-7%); typical pros lose 11% after the same shot (difference -11 points, 95% CI -13 to -4, n=970).

xp.caveat: Read this first: xP from shot and position data has no signal mid-rally in elite singles (holdout AUC 0.50 on strokes that did not end the rally). The same features reach AUC 0.79 only on final strokes, where the task is classifying how an already-decisive stroke ends (winner or error), not predicting a rally. Nothing in this section is a working expected-points model.
